edges.limitations: The genotype is not the patients'. The mice are homozygous for the activating allele, whereas the patients carry it opposite a hypomorphic allele, and in the human cell-line experiments the hypomorphic partner is what unmasks the activating allele. So the model tests the activating allele's effect rather than the two-allele configuration.

edges.description: Antigen-specific follicular helper T cells expand more in knock-in mice than in wild-type after acute LCMV infection, with higher IgG and IgG1 in aged animals.
edges.limitations: The expansion needed an acute viral infection to appear and, on a polyclonal repertoire, did not produce more germinal-centre B cells or higher anti-LCMV titres. No autoantibody arose in these mice, so the step from expanded help to pathogenic autoantibody is not modelled.

edges.description: The knock-in mice do not break tolerance in any observable way: no spontaneous autoimmune disease on organ histology, no lymphadenopathy or splenomegaly, and no ANA or anti-dsDNA antibodies.
edges.limitations: C57BL/6 is relatively resistant to autoimmunity, and the authors attribute the negative result to background, modifiers or environment rather than to the allele being harmless. Aged knock-in mice also accumulate regulatory and anergic T cells, which may be actively containing the enhanced signalling. A negative result here therefore does not refute the human mechanism, but it does mean the tolerance-breaking step rests on the patients and on inference.

nodes.description: p.R360P sits in a loop of the kinase N-lobe beside Tyr315 and Tyr319, the interdomain B residues that hold the kinase in its autoinhibited conformation. The substitution destabilises that arrangement, leaving the kinase partially constitutively active: in T-cell lines it raises TCR-induced phosphorylation of ZAP-70 itself and of its substrates LAT and SLP-76, raises Erk phosphorylation, and raises basal CD69. The effect is weak, which is consistent with a single copy beside wild-type ZAP70 being clinically silent.

nodes.description: The diseases that defined this syndrome are antibody-defined: bullous pemphigoid with linear basement-membrane IgG at a titre above 1:160, and an inhibitory autoantibody to coagulation factor VIII causing bleeding. Both point at autoreactive B-cell help as the effector arm rather than at direct T-cell cytotoxicity. The node is scaled CELLULAR because its substrate is the antibody-secreting cell; the organ-level consequences are the phenotypes downstream of it. Tolerance is recorded as broken rather than as an intrinsic B-cell defect: ZAP-70 is expressed predominantly in T and NK cells, and the proposed cause is excess T-cell help.

nodes.description: Mature T cells that react to self peptide-MHC are normally held below the activation threshold. When the threshold is lowered, such cells can be driven by self ligands in a permissive cytokine environment, which the authors propose as the route from the kinase defect to organ-directed autoimmunity. Unlike the hypomorphic ZAP70 alleles studied in mice, where forbidden clones escape thymic deletion, the activating allele acts mainly on mature cells: thymic negative selection is if anything strengthened, and knock-in mice accumulate regulatory and anergic T cells rather than autoimmunity.

nodes.description: Help to B cells is the step that connects a T-cell signalling defect to an antibody-mediated disease, and it is the part of the chain the mouse model supports most directly. After acute LCMV infection, R360P knock-in mice expand antigen-specific follicular helper T cells more than wild-type mice, and aged knock-in mice carry higher total IgG and IgG1. ZAP-70 is expressed predominantly in T and NK cells, so excess T-cell help, rather than an intrinsic B-cell defect, is the proposed explanation for why these patients make pathogenic autoantibodies.

nodes.description: CRISPR-generated knock-in carrying the activating allele in the homozygous state. The mice are healthy, fertile and normal-lived, and they do not develop autoimmunity: histology of multiple organs at 8 to 10 months was unremarkable and ANA and anti-dsDNA screening was negative. What they do show is the signalling phenotype. Thymocyte and peripheral T-cell development is grossly normal, but central memory CD8 cells increase, ZAP70 Y319 phosphorylation and calcium mobilisation are enhanced, follicular helper T cells expand after LCMV infection, and aged animals have more IgG and IgG1. Crossing in the OTI transgenic TCR removes repertoire compensation and reveals selectively enhanced responses to weak agonist and self peptides.
